svg.text: YAML config only · zero new code per source
weekly trigger · ID management · crash-safe · deduplication before any compute
weekly trigger · queries each registered source
checks for new papers since last run
standard ID (PMID · DOI · NCT) → used directly
no ID (PDF · HTML) → SHA-256 hash generated
ID written BEFORE dispatch · exists → skip
7 steps · one format downstream · all sources treated identically
Step 1 — Format detection · reads HTTP Content-Type · identifies XML / JSON / HTML / PDF / plain text · under 1 ms · no LLM
Step 2 — Raw fetch · right handler per format
Step 3 — Text cleaning · strips boilerplate · converts tables + captions to sentences · hallucination risk near zero
Strips: author affiliations · nav bars · funding · copyright · ads · headers · footers · Output: clean full document text · no splitting yet
Step 4 — Coreference resolution · runs on FULL document before chunking · replaces all pronouns + vague references with explicit entity names
trained on scientific literature · runs on CPU · pip install
lightweight · no GPU · no data leaves
state-of-the-art · stronger on complex scientific text
heavier than s2e-coref · still runs fully locally
no GPU · no API · no data leaves · via COREF_SERVICE_URL
Before: “Rapamycin was given daily. It reduced mTOR activity.” → After: “Rapamycin was given daily. Rapamycin reduced mTOR activity.” — every sentence self-contained
Step 5 — Section splitting · splits resolved document into natural sections · each section = coherent biological context
Step 6 — Context-window chunking · tiktoken token counting · content determines chunk count · not arbitrary fixed size
entire section = one chunk = one LLM call
LLM sees full section · no distant-relationship problem
Section does not fit in context window
split at paragraph boundaries · chunks near window limit
sliding overlap: last 1–2 sentences repeated in next chunk
Step 7 — Metadata attachment · every chunk carries document_id · source_name · section_tag · chunk_index · downstream layers never ask where text came from
links all chunks to same paper
Output: clean · coreference-resolved · self-contained · section-tagged · token-accurate · metadata-rich · same format every source
NER ensemble (4 taggers) + NLI negation detector · all run before LLM sees text
isolates entity sub-clause at contrastive conjunctions (“but not” · “however” · “although”) → NLI contradiction prob >0.45 → negated=True, assertion=ABSENT
most critical gate: wrong biology stored as confirmed fact if missed
Also: DOI extractor (regex) replaces SHA-256 doc_id if DOI found in text · AccessionDetector extracts GEO · SRA · UniProt · RefSeq accessions
defined once · closed world · complete enforcement system
wrong field → rejected with specific error
Pydantic rejects → Instructor feeds error to LLM
up to 3 retries · fail → rejected queue · never lost
LLM reads fully prepared text · leaky-bucket concurrency · Pydantic retry loop
receives: chunk + section tag + entity tags + negation flag + schema
mandatory reasoning trace ≥50 chars · multi-relation → array
local on GPU · data never leaves · temperature 0.0
leaky-bucket: min(workers, total) chunks submitted · each completion slots next
3 attempts exhausted → data/rejected.jsonl · never silently dropped
LLM_GLOBAL_CONCURRENCY · LLM_CHUNK_CONCURRENCY · LLM_WALL_TIMEOUT · LLM_SUBMIT_INTERVAL · all tunable via env
8 steps in sequence · makes knowledge graph trustworthy and queryable
final safety net for distant chunks
Output: normalized · deduplicated · contradiction-checked · cross-linked · semantically validated · confidence-scored · ready for publish
final routing · dual-format KG write · human review queue · verification · vis.js graph
VALID + no contradiction + canonical ID resolved + entity_type not OTHER → auto-insert · any flag → human review
UI: approve → staging DB · reject → REJECTED
checks entity names vs source chunk
staging DB → data/triple_store_neo4j.db · data/triple_store_metta.db (SQLite) · unified graph HTML rebuilt · compare pages regenerated
